en: Improved token counts behind a Claude apps gateway on Amazon Bedrock, which `/context` and large file reads use: the gateway now gets them from AWS's CountTokens API instead of a one-token model request. Grant `bedrock:CountTokens` to use it
zh: 改进 Amazon Bedrock 上 Claude 应用网关背后的 token 计数，`/context` 和大文件读取会用到：网关现在从 AWS 的 CountTokens API 获取，而不再发送单 token 的模型请求。使用前需授予 `bedrock:CountTokens`
